feature_type: pose-only (shoulder/elbow/wrist), NOT hand shape — see module docstring
limitations: Trained on pose (arm/body) landmarks only, not hand shape — cannot reliably distinguish signs that differ mainly in hand configuration rather than arm movement/position.
3-22 samples per class is a small-data regime; per-class accuracy varies a lot — see per_class_cv_accuracy, do not trust the macro average alone for any specific sign.
Source videos are a specific dataset (see ml/training/README.md) recorded in a fairly uniform setting; real-world webcam conditions (lighting, camera angle, signer variation) are untested.
